states.UNKNOWN: Default for every new canonical record; no claim of complete prior observations.
states.INCOMPLETE: Known missing interval, ambiguous legacy event, correction or incomplete network coverage. Future replay must fail closed.
states.COMPLETE_VERIFIED: Future separately verified source/ledger scope, first observations and complete ordered coverage through the decision key.
states.TRUE_COLD_START_VERIFIED: Future authoritative evidence that no earlier participation exists in the declared observation scope; not inferred from an empty SELECT.

promotion_policy: No public ingestion parameter may assert history completeness. Only a separately authorized verification workflow can persist attestations; no such workflow is activated in Stage2.

historical_classes.CANONICAL_VERIFIED: A validated stored canonical event of the exact version; says nothing about completeness or independent data provenance.
historical_classes.LEGACY_CONVERTIBLE: Reviewed deterministic event candidate with authority reference and reviewer. Not automatically stored, replayed or a completeness certificate.
historical_classes.LEGACY_AMBIGUOUS: Default without authoritative conversion; excluded from replay but never silently omitted from a required history.
